messages.subject: More on colour()
parts:
Hi:

Another colour-color mismatch:

> pseg2 + theme_bw() + opts(strip.background = theme_rect(color = 'cornsilk'))
Error in theme_rect(color = "cornsilk") :
  unused argument(s) (color = "cornsilk")
> pseg2 + theme_bw() + opts(strip.background = theme_rect(colour = 'cornsilk'))
# Works

Dennis
